translation: Greatly warm, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to warm the center, boost qi, dissolve phlegm, down-drive qi, treat cholera (霍亂) and abdominal pain, distension and fullness, cold counter-flow of the stomach center, unremitting vomiting in the chest, diarrhea, dripping discharge (淋露), dispel fright, remove lingering heat, stop vexation and fullness, and thicken the intestines and stomach
